indexes.name: jobs_active_dedup_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX jobs_active_dedup_uniq_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (dedup_key) WHERE ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::"JobStatus", 'running'::"JobStatus"])) AND (dedup_key IS NOT NULL))
indexes.reason: At most one pending or running job per dedup_key; a partial unique index Prisma cannot express (the queue relies on it instead of a find-then-insert).

indexes.name: jobs_attempts_gt1_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_attempts_gt1_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (attempts) WHERE (attempts > 1)
indexes.reason: Partial index over retried jobs (attempts > 1) for the queue insights report; Prisma cannot express a WHERE clause.

indexes.name: jobs_succeeded_duration_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX jobs_succeeded_duration_idx ON public.jobs USING btree (finished_at, started_at, type) WHERE ((status = 'succeeded'::"JobStatus") AND (started_at IS NOT NULL) AND (finished_at IS NOT NULL))
indexes.reason: Partial index over finished succeeded jobs for the duration percentiles of the queue insights report; Prisma cannot express a WHERE clause.

indexes.name: database_backup_runs_active_uniq_idx
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX database_backup_runs_active_uniq_idx ON public.database_backup_runs USING btree ((true)) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::"DatabaseBackupStatus", 'running'::"DatabaseBackupStatus"]))
indexes.reason: At most one pending or running database backup at a time: a constant-expression partial unique index Prisma cannot express.
